description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects shell metacharacters in the documented g0 JSON field on accessv2.
affected_versions: Progress Software LoadMaster: V7.2.60.0 to <V7.2.63.2, V7.2.54.12 to <V7.2.54.18; Progress Software ECS Connections Manager: V7.2.60.0 to <V7.2.63.2; Progress Software Object Scale Connection Manager: V7.2.60.0 to <V7.2.63.2; Progress Software MOVEit WAF: V7.2.60.0 to <V7.2.63.2; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects shell metacharacters in the documented g0 JSON field on accessv2.
limitations: Only the g0 JSON field is inspected; other fields and form bodies are not covered. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate g0 values containing shell punctuation are denied.
